title: Build voice-scan.py: deterministic+semantic scanner at paragraph level
description:

Path: .claude/tools/voice-scan.py
Input: chapter .qmd path
Output: .claude/output/voice-scan-<chapter>.md (paragraph-indexed flag report)

Deterministic per-paragraph: em-dash count, word count, antithesis regex count, triplet detection, forbidden vocab grep, missing contractions, exclamation marks, -ing tag closers, conjunctive-adverb count.

Cross-paragraph: n-gram phrase repetition (>=5-word overlap, non-adjacent paragraphs), cosine similarity via OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (graceful fallback if no API key).

Chapter rollups: total antithesis count (flag >3), total em-dashes (flag >10), pattern frequency.
